title: NCAA: JRU sends San Sebastian to seventh straight loss
summary: Jose Rizal University kept San Sebastian in the hunt for win No. 1, cruising to a 102-78 win in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament on Friday at the PhilSports Arena.
